source_paragraph: At 128k, the three nonzero paired-score differences, identical for offload-local and partition-local, are fwe index 12 (+1/3; local 2/3 versus the other arm 1), qa_2 index 13 (+1; local 0 versus the other arm 1), and qa_2 index 14 (-1; local 1 versus the other arm 0); the first two sorted training pairs are cwe indices 0 and 1, both with zero difference. The frozen range guard counts three departures among the remaining 388 pairs, giving the [-2.2429,+2.2429] pp sidecar. The binary score==1 sidecar passes alone, but both sidecars are required. None of the bootstrap intervals triggers the near-margin sensitivity diagnostic, so no extra-seed result is generated. Finite bootstrap p resolution remains 1/10000.
